title: Ruling on Neck Wiping
summary: Neck wiping is preferable but not obligatory.
translation: The question has been asked about wiping the neck. It should be remembered that wiping the neck is recommended, but it is neither a Sunnah, an obligation, nor a requirement. This should be remembered that this is the Hanafi view. Some people consider it an innovation; they are incorrect. There are five Hadith and several similar narrations that prove that the neck was wiped. The objection that these are weak Hadith is addressed by pointing out that citing weak Hadith is allowed in virtues of actions with consensus among the scholars of Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah. Acting upon a weak Hadith is better than denying or abandoning it. Those who deny neck wiping or call it an innovation are completely wrong. Just as we wipe the ears, we should also wipe the neck. This practice, while following the Hadith, is also very beneficial for physical health because the neck veins can remain fresh if one frequently wipes water over them. Excessive water may not be as beneficial as moist, wet wiping. Doctors have stated that it is an effective way to prevent madness and insanity. However, we practice it because it is a prophetic tradition, not solely for health benefits. Thus, we will receive rewards for following the Hadith and also gain physical protection. We should pray to Allah and practice whatever Hadith have been explained or conveyed to us.
